name: r4-q4-route-blob-tz
description: Fix Q4 (review A2 B2, S1): api.js tzFallback = gateway_timezone setting || 'UTC' and timezone = device.zone_timezone || tzFallback, both as read. The valve list answers it (a Buffer as Buffer JSON) and nextRun formats in it; a new schedule stores it as bound (a Buffer as a BLOB) and answers it. West gateway Etc/GMT+12: B1 X'', B2 '' (gateway), B3 BLOB 'Asia/Tokyo', B4 TEXT Tokyo control, B5 0 (stored '0'). Gateway setting X'': B6 stores X''. Gateway setting BLOB 'Asia/Tokyo': B7 stores that BLOB. East gateway Pacific/Kiritimati: B8 X'', B9 ''. Then the schedule reads, a plan resend and two clock ticks over the stored rows.
